title: Concrete-lined portion of Leadville Mine Drainage Tunnel portal
label: Leadville Tunnel portal interior (2017 or earlier)

sourceNote: Original 600×245 JPEG directly linked from a 2017 official U.S. Bureau of Reclamation Eastern Colorado Area Office article. Photograph shows the concrete-lined LMDT portal/interior and prominent pipe; the original page captions it 'Concrete lined portion of Leadville Tunnel Portal.' Supporting historical infrastructure image, not a reconstruction or unrelated tunnel.
identityEvidence: Exact image and source page visually checked October 14, 2026. The original Bureau of Reclamation page identifies this specific image as 'Concrete lined portion of Leadville Tunnel Portal' in an article explicitly about the Leadville Mine Drainage Tunnel (LMDT) constructed 1943–1952, distinct from other Leadville tunnels.
rightsEvidence: Original photograph published and directly hosted by U.S. Bureau of Reclamation in its own Eastern Colorado Area Office staff-authored 2017 article with no third-party photographer/rights credit. Reclamation's official Effective Graphics Guide (2020), §4.9.2.1 directs credit to Reclamation for site images with unnamed photographer; §4.9.2.3 treats Reclamation-created material as public domain and requires permission for third-party images. DOI copyright policy https://www.doi.gov/copyright confirms federal-produced photographs are public domain with third-party exceptions. No outside figure credit identified for this specific image.
